purpose: Fix the simple L1.75-vs-market value axis, evaluate every priced TRIO containing that axis, and select tickets using partner context plus live TRIO odds.

axis_policy.selection: highest p3_calibrated, then larger rank gap, then larger Outsider score, then better consensus rank

ticket_policy.candidate_space: all priced unordered TRIO tickets containing the frozen axis

policy_selection.source: strict prior chronological calibration slice only
policy_selection.objective: maximize minimum ROI across two chronological calibration halves, then pooled calibration ROI
